organize.reason: Shows a way to organize saved notes into a structured markdown wiki, with Claude doing the structuring.

organize.quote: Defuddle (extracts clean markdown from web pages, stripping unnecessary content to conserve tokens)
organize.reason: Skills for turning web content into markdown notes and managing a markdown vault.

local-llm.reason: Picks and downloads local models to fit the GPU you have.

hybrid-memory.reason: Memory for coding agents built from markdown records with lexical search, close to the brief's design.

wiki-scale.reason: Measures indexing and search time on a markdown corpus, and shows the gap of not checking whether search finds the right records.

ocr-bench.reason: A vision model that turns PDFs into markdown and fits a 16 GB GPU, plus a benchmark suite to score against.

agent-viz.reason: Runs many coding agents with a live web UI and session view you could borrow from.

local-llm.reason: A tested config for Qwen 3.8 with long context on a 24 GB card, plus advice on choosing hardware and inference stacks.

agent-viz.quote: A dead runner was invisible for days with no failure marker
agent-viz.reason: Lessons on heartbeats and health checks for spotting agent loops that hang or die.

hybrid-memory.quote: Hybrid index (vector + BM25 keyword), AI agents for retrieval orchestration, configurable chunk sizes and reranking
hybrid-memory.reason: A reference design for agentic RAG with hybrid search to compare against.

hybrid-memory.quote: Markdown + YAML frontmatter; adds provenance/freshness/trust signals
hybrid-memory.reason: A spec for typed, linked markdown knowledge records that closely matches the brief's record format.

ocr-bench.quote: fast deterministic local mode (Java-based, ~60 pages/sec on CPU)
ocr-bench.reason: A CPU PDF parser with a hybrid AI mode and benchmark comparisons against docling and marker.

agent-viz.quote: Agent Canvas (frontend) connects to one or more Agent Servers (backend REST API)
agent-viz.reason: A web UI for watching and managing coding-agent sessions across servers.
